paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.27% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+2.51%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.84%). Brent crude changed +2.04% to 94.46. Gold changed -5.88% to 3,872.6001. Bitcoin changed -13.25% to 64,166.1992. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.154%, a relative move of +6.07%. Among the firms tracked, Invesco (+7.61%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (-6.80%) moved the most.
